text:
mari: Heads up — I'm starting a proposal to migrate from event-per-row telemetry to a compact time-series metrics table for console dashboards and quota recalcs. The goal is fewer reads for dashboard queries and deterministic quota evaluation.

kevin: 👍 important. Can you sketch schema? worried about losing detail for debug traces.

mari: rough idea:

```sql
CREATE TABLE console_metrics (
  org_id UUID,
  route_id UUID,
  ts_bucket TIMESTAMP, -- start of 1m bucket
  tokens_total BIGINT,
  requests INT,
  errors INT,
  PRIMARY KEY ((org_id), route_id, ts_bucket)
);
```

jia: why composite PK like that? partitioning by org helps tenancy, but route_id should be in partition key to avoid hotspots for very active routes.

mari: we chose org first for tenant isolation. we can make route_id part of partitioning strategy later — open to alternatives.

sam: how will this affect existing quotas which rely on per-request attributes (model, prompt_size)?

mari: plan: keep full events in cold store for fidelity for 90 days, and compute aggregated metrics at ingest-time with enrichers that emit per-minute rolls that feed console_metrics. quotas will read the aggregated counters and fall back to event scan for edge cases.

kevin: fallback scans worry me. they could be huge. add an async precompute for quota-critical routes that keep a sliding window cache.

mari: yes, proposal includes a 'hot' cache table with TTL for quota-critical routes. also a feature flag per-tenant for rollout.

ops-bot: migration-runner started for org=redwood-internal batch=0/20

jia: backfill approach? do we re-aggregate historical events into buckets? that could be expensive.

mari: backfill plan staged:
1) start with last 7 days for beta orgs
2) parallel mapreduce jobs that aggregate into ts_bucket
3) verify checksum vs original aggregates
4) gradually extend to 90 days

sam: rollback? if we discover aggregation bug, how do we recover quotas and dashboards?

mari: keep idempotent re-aggregation jobs and a short write-ahead log of changes to console_metrics. rollback is re-applying corrected aggregates. also include a toggle to route console queries to legacy event view.

kevin: will dashboards need query rewrite? Grafana panels that currently hit events will need to switch to console_metrics; prefer building a compatibility view layer in query service.

mari: agreed. I'll add a metrics adapter in query-service that exposes both event_view and metrics_view under same API so console UX doesn't change.

jia: sounds reasonable. minor nit: SQL above needs an index on (org_id, ts_bucket, route_id) to cover common queries.

mari: good catch — will add multi-column index and explain expected query patterns in the doc. plan to open PR for DDL + migration playbook tomorrow.

sam: 👍 please include cost estimate for BigQuery/ClickHouse storage and CPU for backfill.

mari: will do. cc @kevin @jia @sam — feedback welcome; tagging infra to review partitioning strategy.
